parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State one difference between a hadron and a lepton.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
A proton within a nucleus decays to form a neutron and two other particles. A partial equation to represent this decay is

$$^{1}_{1}\mathrm{p} \rightarrow {}^{1}_{0}\mathrm{n} + {}^{\ldots}_{\ldots}\ldots + {}^{\ldots}_{\ldots}\ldots$$

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the name of the interaction or force that gives rise to this decay.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Use the quark composition of a proton to show that it has a charge of $+e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge.

Explain your working.
